models_evaluated: Four LLMs (not named in the abstract)

links.outcome: Reading grade level of LLM-generated ACL patient education materials
links.effect: Mean Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level ranged from 9.9 (SD=0.8; Low SES persona) to 11.4 (SD=1.5; Boy persona), which is a difficult reading level.
links.quote: Mean Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level ranged between 9.9 (SD=0.8; Low SES persona) and 11.4 (SD=1.5; Boy persona).

links.outcome: Language differences in LLM outputs across sex/gender/ethnic/SES personas
links.effect: No statistically significant language differences between personas across LLMs (p>.05) using Kruskal-Wallis and Mann-Whitney U tests.
links.quote: The Kruskal-Wallis test and Mann-Whitney U test revealed no statistically significant language differences between personas, across LLMs (p>.05).

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM performance across different personas for patient education materials regarding readability, bias, understandability, and tone, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
